approvalSource: User request to diversify catalog classification, reduce misclassification, and run the unified release daily

scope.managedTags: exact replacement within checked-in salt managed namespaces
scope.taxonomyClassification: deterministic checked-in taxonomy first; guarded local image evidence only for opaque products; auditable release-boundary guess only if the release would otherwise fail
scope.seo: product-specific SEO and metafields required for every active Shopify product; generic, duplicate, or evidence-free content blocks release; prices preserved
scope.salesChannel: publish every active product to every available sales channel only after all release tasks verify; never change draft or archived status
scope.categoriesAndMetafields: classification and product-specific merchandising metafields plus controlled collection tags approved for every active Shopify product; no Shopify product category writes
scope.existingCollections: repair canonical title, handle, exact source condition, and exact membership for every checked-in governed collection
scope.newCollections: approved only for missing canonical collections in the checked-in governance registry
scope.collectionHandleMigrations: approved only for explicitly checked-in legacy handle mappings with redirects
scope.zeroImageProducts: delete only after a fresh live Shopify image read confirms zero product images
scope.prices: preserve product and variant prices; collection price conditions may be repaired exactly
scope.variants: mapping and readback only; never mutate price or compare-at price
